	"sql": "select plan_id, plan from (SELECT  \"plan\".*,\"billing_scheme\".\"billing_scheme\" AS \"billing_scheme\",\"payment_provider\".\"payment_provider\" AS \"payment_provider\",\"provider\".\"provider\" AS \"provider\",\"currency\".\"currency\" AS \"currency\",\"product\".\"product\" AS \"product\",\"recurring_interval\".\"recurring_interval\" AS \"recurring_interval\" FROM \"plan\" LEFT OUTER JOIN \"billing_scheme\" \"billing_scheme\" ON \"billing_scheme\".\"billing_scheme_id\" = \"plan\".\"billing_scheme_id\"\nLEFT OUTER JOIN \"payment_provider\" \"payment_provider\" ON \"payment_provider\".\"payment_provider_id\" = \"plan\".\"payment_provider_id\"\nLEFT OUTER JOIN \"provider\" \"provider\" ON \"provider\".\"provider_id\" = \"plan\".\"provider_id\"\nLEFT OUTER JOIN \"currency\" \"currency\" ON \"currency\".\"currency_id\" = \"plan\".\"currency_id\"\nLEFT OUTER JOIN \"product\" \"product\" ON \"product\".\"product_id\" = \"plan\".\"product_id\"\nLEFT OUTER JOIN \"recurring_interval\" \"recurring_interval\" ON \"recurring_interval\".\"recurring_interval_id\" = \"plan\".\"recurring_interval_id\" WHERE (\"plan\".\"excluded\" IS FALSE AND (\"plan\".\"plan_id\" IN (?) OR \"plan\".\"user_id\" = ?) AND (\"product\".\"product_id\" IN (?) OR \"product\".\"user_id\" = ?)) LIMIT 10 OFFSET 0) as t",
